categories.main_business_segments: Jinhong Gas Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated gas service provider specializing in the research, production, sales, and service of industrial gases. Its primary business segments include specialty gases (such as ultra-pure ammonia, high-purity nitrous oxide, electronic-grade silicate esters, high-purity carbon dioxide, and hydrogen), bulk gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, acetylene), and fuel gases (natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas). The company also provides comprehensive gas management services including Total Gas and Chemical Management (TGCM) for semiconductor and other high-tech industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including air separation, chemical synthesis, physical purification, gas filling, gas mixing, and gas detection. Core proprietary technologies include gas purification, tail gas recovery and purification, cryogenic continuous supply (deep cold fast line), high-purity gas packaging treatment, safe and efficient logistics and distribution, and comprehensive process control from production to delivery. It holds numerous patents in these areas and actively participates in national standards formulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinhong Gas serves a broad range of industries including electronics and semiconductors, medical and healthcare, energy conservation and environmental protection, new materials, new energy, high-end equipment manufacturing, food, metallurgy, chemical, and machinery manufacturing. Key customers include major semiconductor manufacturers, LCD panel producers, LED companies, fiber optic communication firms, and photovoltaic enterprises. The company also serves industrial gas companies and retail customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Suzhou, China, with extensive operations across the Yangtze River Delta region and expanding presence in other key economic zones such as the Pearl River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin, and Chongqing-Chengdu areas. It has established subsidiaries and projects in multiple Chinese provinces and has begun overseas expansion with subsidiaries in Vietnam, Thailand, and Singapore, serving nearly 50 countries worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinhong Gas operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial gas supply chain. It procures raw materials such as industrial ammonia and gases, produces purified and specialty gases, and supplies these to end-users and gas companies. It also provides on-site gas generation (site gas production) and comprehensive gas management services, positioning itself as a full-service gas supplier and solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes vertical development through continuous R&D investment focused on developing high-purity specialty gases and electronic chemicals critical for the semiconductor industry, aiming to break foreign monopolies. It pursues horizontal expansion via regional market integration and overseas market development. R&D priorities include gas purification, tail gas recovery, hydrogen production, carbon capture and utilization, and advanced gas packaging and logistics technologies. It maintains strong industry-academic partnerships and holds numerous patents and national standards leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Jinhong Gas generates revenue primarily through the sale of specialty gases, bulk gases, and fuel gases via multiple supply modes including bottled gas, bulk storage tanks, and on-site gas production. It operates mainly on a direct sales model to end customers and gas companies, with contracts typically based on volume and pricing agreements. Additional revenue streams include comprehensive gas and chemical management services, engineering services, and logistics support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major multinational industrial gas giants such as Linde, Air Liquide, Air Products, and Taiyo Nippon Sanso, which dominate the global and Chinese markets, especially in high-end specialty gases. Jinhong Gas is a leading domestic player with a strong position in specialty and bulk gases, recognized as a top private gas company in China. It is actively expanding market share and technological capabilities to challenge foreign dominance, particularly in semiconductor gases.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jinhong Gas reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.53 billion, a 4.03% increase over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 201.23 million, reflecting a 36.12% decrease due to market competition and increased R&D and capital expenditures. Total assets reached RMB 6.77 billion, and shareholders' equity was RMB 3.06 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and asset base, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinhong Gas differentiates itself through its comprehensive product portfolio covering over a hundred gas varieties, advanced proprietary technologies, and integrated service capabilities including TGCM. It emphasizes high product purity and quality, especially in electronic specialty gases, achieving import substitution levels. The company offers flexible supply modes tailored to customer needs, strong logistics and on-site gas production services, and a commitment to environmental sustainability and innovation, positioning itself as a reliable and innovative national brand in the industrial gas sector.
